statement: Target gene 'rpoB' is detected in the current assembly.
alternative_explanations: the hit may be a paralogue
the hit may be a conserved domain fragment
the hit may lie on a contaminant contig
detection in this assembly is not proof of function
inconsistent synteny can indicate paralogy, rearrangement, or a wrong locus

falsification_tests.name: wrong paralogue
falsification_tests.hypothesis: The hit is a paralogue rather than the intended gene.

falsification_tests.name: short conserved-domain match
falsification_tests.hypothesis: The hit is only a short conserved domain, not the full gene.

falsification_tests.name: low alignment coverage
falsification_tests.hypothesis: Alignment covers too little of the query to support full-gene detection.

falsification_tests.name: abnormal protein length
falsification_tests.hypothesis: Predicted protein length is inconsistent with the target.

falsification_tests.name: missing expected catalytic residues
falsification_tests.hypothesis: Expected catalytic residues are missing or substituted.
falsification_tests.limitation: no catalytic residue pattern was provided; residues were not invented

rationale: Adversarial attack plan AP_target_gene_detected_rpoB was executed with deterministic measurements. Status 'weakened' is a claim-state, not certainty.
